question_text:
Under standard government filing rules, numbers written as digits (e.g., '5th Avenue') are filed as if spelled out in words. Arrange these 4 file folders in proper alphabetical order:
1. 5th Avenue Bakery
2. Fifth Street Laundry
3. 50th Street Pharmacy
4. Five Star Catering
